content.what_it_is: Python (numpy/matplotlib) port of the tohoku_tsunami surface snapshot plot for FUNWAVE-TVD postprocessing (workshop version). It loads depth_30min.txt and sets the output folder fdir from hardcoded user paths (L11, L13), derives n,m and 0.5-degree lon/lat coordinates with origins 132.01667/-59.98333 (L16-L21), selects snapshots nfile=[2, 9] labeled hr=['1','8'] (L23-L24), creates a 5x7-inch, 200-dpi figure (L27-L31), and per snapshot (L33-L56): loads eta_<fnum> (L34-L35), masks land with np.ma.masked_where(dep<0,eta) (L36), draws pcolor with jet colormap in stacked subplots (L38-L40), titles 'Time = <hr> hr' with tight axes (L42-L44), labels Lat/Lon and adds an eta (m) colorbar (L46-L49), sets clim(-0.5,0.5) for the first panel and (-0.05,0.05) otherwise (L51-L54), and updates rcParams font size 10 (L56). Saves eta_tsunami.png (L58).
entities: script (no function/class definitions; top-level Python script)

verbatim_spans.text: eta_masked = np.ma.masked_where(dep<0,eta) # do nt plot where dep<0
nfile = [2, 9]    # range of eta files you want to plot

unresolved: Snapshot-to-hour mapping [2,9] -> ['1','8'] implies a 3600 s output interval, consistent with the MATLAB sibling but not verifiable from this file.
dep and eta must come from the same run/grid for the mask (L36) to align; both are hardcoded workshop paths (L11, L13).
mat.rcParams.update (L56) is called inside the loop after most text is drawn; rcParams affect subsequently created elements, so first-panel fonts may differ.
